pr_title: chore: move sdkLanguage over to the protocol init call

issue_context.title: [Bug]: Playwright executable path not found message should be cross-language compatible
issue_context.body:
Problem: We currently show on Python etc. npx playwright install when the executables are not installed.

https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/b56e2b713a6ec4b95faaa9d6e3ced9bb538c4c2e/src/utils/registry.ts#L252-L259

Needs protocol changes. Since we should notify the server early on which language we are. Either when we launch or better before. Currently its done on newContext.

Environment variables are not the best there, since if we do it over WS, then its not working.

review_comments: Let's rename language to sdkLanguage for consistency.
